summary: 建筑师迈克尔·文特里斯长期研究线形文字 B，借符号排列网格及克里特地名对应，发现泥板记录的是早期希腊语。传记回顾建筑训练、公开交换研究笔记，以及与查德威克合作验证成果的过程。
logic: 少年文特里斯如何接触未解文字
从建筑训练到全心投入破译
交流研究笔记，用网格排列符号
通过克里特地名推出符号读音
与查德威克合作出版及其后的人生

paragraphs.brief: 建筑师与线形文字B之谜
sentences: The decipherment of Minoan Linear B by architect Michael Ventris is one of the great dramas of 20th-century archaeology.
建筑师迈克尔·文特里斯破译米诺斯线形文字B，是二十世纪考古史上最引人入胜的故事之一。
But who was Michael Ventris, and how did he do it?
但文特里斯是谁，又是怎样做到的？
paragraphs.gist: 一位建筑师如何破解长期难解的线形文字B，由此成为二十世纪考古史上一段格外引人关注的经历。

sentences: Andrew Robinson, the Literary Editor of the Times Higher Education Supplement, has now written a fascinating biography, The Man Who Deciphered Linear B.
《泰晤士高等教育增刊》文学编辑安德鲁·罗宾逊现已写成一本引人入胜的传记，题为《破译线形文字 B 的人》。
paragraphs.gist: 《泰晤士高等教育增刊》文学编辑安德鲁·罗宾逊以新传记讲述了破解线形文字B的建筑师文特里斯。

sentences: Michael Ventris was born in 1922 into a well-to-do military family.
迈克尔·文特里斯于1922年生于家境优裕的军人家庭。
His mother was half Polish – and artistic – so he was brought up to chatter away in Polish, but his father suffered from TB and went to Switzerland to find a cure.
母亲有一半波兰血统，很有艺术修养，所以他从小就会用波兰语聊天；父亲则因肺结核前往瑞士求医。
Therefore, Michael received his early education in Switzerland, so that by the age of 10 he was fluent in English, Polish, French and German.
因此迈克尔早年在瑞士受教育，十岁时已能流利使用英语、波兰语、法语和德语。
Being a superb natural linguist, he ended up speaking most European languages fluently.
他极有语言天赋，后来能流利地说大多数欧洲语言。
He studied Latin and Greek at Stowe, and at the age of 14 quizzed Sir Arthur Evans on the Minoan B tablets.
他在斯托学校学习拉丁语和希腊语，十四岁就向阿瑟·埃文斯爵士追问米诺斯线形文字B泥板。
His first major paper on the tablets, proposing that they were a form of Etruscan, was written when he was 18.
十八岁时，他写成第一篇研究这些泥板的重要论文，推测其中使用的是伊特鲁里亚语的一种形式。
However, he also had other interests: his arty mother mixed with the Hampstead artistic set – Ben Nicholson, Henry Moore, and particularly Naum Gabo were all friends.
他也醉心艺术：母亲与汉普斯特德艺术圈交往，本·尼科尔森、亨利·摩尔，尤其是瑙姆·加博都是家中的朋友。
Michael’s interests were split: should he follow his artistic beliefs and become an architect, or should he become a classicist and continue his attempts to decipher the unknown script?
迈克尔面临两难：是遵循艺术志向当建筑师，还是成为古典学者，继续破译未知文字？
paragraphs.gist: 文特里斯十岁已通四种语言，十四岁便询问泥板文字，十八岁发表研究，同时母亲的艺术圈也让他在古典学与建筑之间难以取舍。

paragraphs.brief: 建筑学业被战时服役打断
sentences: He decided to become an architect and enrolled in the Architectural Association, already a hotbed of modern architecture.
他决定当建筑师，进入当时已是现代建筑思想重镇的建筑联盟学院。
But then the war intervened, and he joined the RAF, surviving a tour of duty bombing Germany in Halifaxes in 1945.
但战争打断了学业。他加入英国皇家空军，1945年驾驶哈利法克斯轰炸机参加对德轰炸任务，平安生还。
paragraphs.gist: 他先选择建筑并进入建筑联盟学院学习，但战争中断了学业，他加入英国皇家空军并在1945年参加赴德国的轰炸任务。

paragraphs.brief: 重返现代建筑与组织才能
sentences: After the war he returned to architecture.
战后他重返建筑行业。
At first it was very exciting; a brave new world of socialism and modern architecture was being constructed and he wanted to take part in it.
最初他十分兴奋，社会主义与现代建筑的新世界正在建设中，他也想参与。
He did not, however, have the talent to become a great architect; his strength lay as an organiser.
不过，他的长处在组织协调，并没有成为伟大建筑师的天分。
paragraphs.gist: 战后他满怀热情重返现代建筑事业，却逐渐显出长处在协调组织，未必能成为顶尖建筑设计师。

paragraphs.brief: 新泥板促使他专心破译
sentences: Gradually his interest in Minoan script reasserted itself.
他对米诺斯文字的兴趣渐渐重新占了上风。
This was the crucial time for the decipherment.
那正是破译工作的关键时刻。
The script had originally been discovered by Sir Arthur Evans, but as he grew older, Evans sat on these discoveries, hoping to decipher them himself.
最初发现这些文字的阿瑟·埃文斯爵士到了晚年一直不肯公开材料，希望亲自破解。
Then, dramatically, more tablets were discovered, this time by the American Carl Blegen, at Pylos.
后来美国人卡尔·布莱根又在皮洛斯发现更多泥板，事情出现转机。
The lure of the tablets gripped Ventris.
文特里斯深深被这些泥板吸引。

Although by now he had a wife and two young children, he decided to give up architecture and live off his private income for a year or so and devote himself full-time to the decipherment of the tablets.
虽已有妻子和两个年幼的孩子，他仍决定暂停建筑事业，靠私人收入生活一年左右，全力破译泥板文字。
paragraphs.gist: 埃文斯长期未公布的材料和皮洛斯新出土的泥板重燃他的兴趣，尽管已有家室，他仍决定依靠个人收入暂停建筑工作，全心破译。

paragraphs.brief: 用工作笔记向同行公开进展
sentences: He had two main methods of working, both with precedents from his architectural training.
他主要有两种工作方法，都可追溯到受建筑训练时的经验。
The first was the concept of ‘group working’.
第一种是团队协作。
With extraordinary generosity, he established a system of ‘Work Notes’, which he sent out to his colleagues and possible rivals round the world.
他十分慷慨，把研究进展编为“工作笔记”，寄给世界各地的同事乃至可能的竞争者。
paragraphs.gist: 他把建筑训练中的团队协作引入破译，主动将自己的工作笔记分送给各地的同事，甚至包括潜在竞争者。

paragraphs.brief: 音节方格与地名突破口
sentences: The other technical device was that of a grid.
另一件技术工具是方格表。
It had long been clear that Linear B was a syllabary – that is, each sign represented a combined consonant and vowel.
人们早已知道线形文字B是音节文字，也就是每个符号表示一个辅音和元音的组合。
How did they fit together?
这些组合究竟怎样对应？
He devised a grid with five vowels across the top, V1–5, and fifteen consonants down the side, C1–15.
他设计了一张方格表，横排五个元音V1至V5，纵列十五个辅音C1至C15。
His grids were drawn up with architectural precision, and lettered with his superb lettering ability.
方格画得像建筑制图一样精确，字母也以他出色的书写功力标注得十分漂亮。
He worked solidly, producing Work Notes at the rate of about one a month.
他持续工作，大约每月完成一份工作笔记。
Then, suddenly, in March 1953, when he was about to produce Work Note 20, the breakthrough was made.
按文中的说法，1953 年 3 月，就在他准备撰写第 20 号工作笔记时，研究突然取得了突破。（译注：此处年份与后文冲突。第 20 号工作笔记写于 1952 年 6 月 1 日，文特里斯于同年 7 月 1 日在 BBC 广播中宣布破译成果。）
Some of the signs appeared to be the names of places.
一些符号组合似乎代表地名。
paragraphs.gist: 他以五个元音和十五个辅音绘制精密方格来推断音节，持续整理笔记，直到察觉有些符号组合可能代表地名，研究才出现突破。

paragraphs.brief: 从地名读出更多希腊语词
sentences: How about trying to see if they fitted the names of the Cretan towns in the classical period?
何不看看这些组合能否对应古典时期克里特岛的城镇名称？
He tried out Amnisos, the port of Knossos.
他先试了克诺索斯的港口阿姆尼索斯。
This fixed several positions on the grid: he applied these to another group, and the word Knossos emerged.
由此确定了表中几个格子的读音，再应用到另一组符号，便读出了“克诺索斯”。
In a rush, more Cretan towns emerged – Tu-li-so (Tulissos), Pa-i-to (Phaestos), and Lu-ki-to (Luktos).
很快更多克里特城镇出现了，包括Tu-li-so、Pa-i-to和Lu-ki-to。
On June 1st, he sat down to type what would turn out to be his final work note, number 20, and boldly titled it ‘Are the Knossos and Pylos tablets written in Greek?’
6月1日，他打出后来成为最后一份的第20号工作笔记，大胆题为《克诺索斯和皮洛斯泥板是用希腊语写的吗？》。
He called this merely a frivolous digression, but rapidly more and more words began to fit in.
他称这不过是一次随意的题外尝试，可很快越来越多词语都能对应得上。
Carpenters, wainwrights, chairmakers and bakers made their appearance, as did Father (pa-te) and the people (da-mo).
木匠、造车匠、制椅匠和面包师等词相继出现，还有“父亲”（pa-te）与“人民”（da-mo）。
paragraphs.gist: 从阿姆尼索斯等克里特城镇名入手，他逐格确定读音，进而读出职业和亲属称呼，开始认真考虑泥板记的就是希腊语。

paragraphs.brief: 广播引出查德威克的合作
sentences: A BBC producer happened to come to dinner.
一位英国广播公司的节目制作人碰巧来吃晚饭。
She realised she had a scoop, and on the 1st July 1952, the decipherment was announced on the Third Programme.
她意识到这是独家新闻。1952年7月1日，BBC第三套节目播出了成功破译的消息。
At Cambridge, a young scholar of early Greek dialects, John Chadwick, heard the programme, and immediately offered to help.
在剑桥研究早期希腊方言的年轻学者约翰·查德威克听了节目，立即主动提出帮忙。
A pioneering book, Documents in Mycenaean Greek, was written jointly by Ventris and Chadwick, and published by the Cambridge University Press.
文特里斯与查德威克合著了开创性的《迈锡尼希腊语文献》，由剑桥大学出版社出版。
paragraphs.gist: 一位BBC制作人促成破译消息播出，剑桥的希腊方言学者查德威克听后主动协助，两人随后合著迈锡尼希腊语研究著作。

sentences: The world was at his feet, but which way should he go?
他已声名大噪，下一步该走哪条路？
The academic world did not entice such a free spirit, so he returned to architecture, but at the end of six months, he was becoming disenchanted.
学界并未吸引住这位性情自由的人，于是他重新从事建筑工作，但半年后又渐感失望。
On the 5th September 1956, he left his new house late at night, and, driving fast down the Barnet bypass, crashed into the back of a stationary lorry, and was killed instantly: he was only 34.
1956年9月5日深夜，他离开新居，在巴尼特绕城公路上高速行驶时撞上停着的卡车尾部，当场死亡，年仅三十四岁。
The suspicion remains that if it was not exactly suicide, it was something close to it.
一直有人怀疑，这场事故即使不能确认为自杀，也和自杀十分接近。
Should one recall perhaps that other frustrated classicist, Lawrence of Arabia, killed on his motorbike?
这是否让人想起另一位失意的古典学者“阿拉伯的劳伦斯”？他死于摩托车事故。
paragraphs.gist: 成名后的文特里斯不愿留在学界，重返建筑又感到失望，1956年深夜发生车祸身亡，年仅三十四岁。

paragraphs.brief: 传记兼顾人生与语言学
sentences: Andrew Robinson, the literary editor of the Times Higher Education Supplement, has written a superb biography of Michael Ventris, combining a warm account of his life with just enough technical details to satisfy those who have knowledge of linguistics or indeed of the classics.
《泰晤士高等教育增刊》文学编辑安德鲁·罗宾逊的这部传记写得很好，既温情讲述文特里斯一生，又提供足够的技术细节，让懂语言学或古典学的读者也能尽兴。
It is a splendid read, and a fine memorial to the split personality that enabled Ventris to decipher Minoan Linear B so triumphantly.
这本书精彩好读，也是对文特里斯性格中两种取向的恰当纪念，正是它们使他得以成功破译米诺斯线形文字B。
paragraphs.gist: 作者赞赏罗宾逊的传记把温暖的人生叙述与适量的语言学细节结合，既纪念文特里斯，也写出他艺术与文字才能交织的一生。

clauses: His first major paper on the tablets, proposing …, was written when he was 18.
“that they were a form of Etruscan”补足 proposing 的内容，交代究竟在说、判断或发现什么。
先读 proposing 所在的主句，再把 that 后面的内容作为一个整体。
…, he decided to give up architecture and live off his private income for a year or so and devote himself full-time to the decipherment of the tablets.
连接词 although 引出“Although by now he had a wife and two young children”，说明主句的让步关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 although 把这一层关系补进去。
